scene_description: A high-stakes starting line scene at the LANCE_HELL_CREEK formation. A start line is carved into the dark organic dirt of a lush forest clearing. Three dinosaurs—the T-Rex, Triceratops, and Velociraptor—are crouched in starting positions, muscles tensed. To the right, Referee 1 (with his signature perfectly round black glasses and striped jersey) holds a checkered flag at the apex of his reach. The composition accounts for a 15% negative space buffer at the bottom for UI overlap.
